title: Permanent Bakeout Heaters for ALS-U
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.BERKELEY NATL LAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: Dear Prospective Offeror: The University of California, on behalf of the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL), would like to invite you to participate in small business set aside, Request for Quote (RFQ) No. AA-2026-07 for Permanent Bakeout Heaters that will be utilized in the ALS-U. The RFQ and associated documents (listed below) are attached: 0. RFQ and submission instructions 1. Sample Subcontract 2. Statement of Work 3. Past Performance Reference Information Form (submit with Quote regardless of value) 4. Rep Cert Form (required with submission if total Quote exceeds $150K) *With your Quote submission, you must certify in writing that you meet and agree to all of the Mandatory Requirements outlined within Doc 0. RFQ AA-2025-07 and will manufacture per SOW. Timeline of Events: RFQ Release - May 14, 2026 Quotes Due - May 29, 2026
